trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc had only ever been in staging and was also unhealthy).
2. **Rolled back**: All regions rolled back to **v2.3.0** and verified healthy — error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.
3. **Incident opened**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** filed for checkout-api documenting the health check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, and verification of recovery. On-call has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production, so a redeploy of it would require change-manager approval under organizational policy.
